(ja)༄༅/ /gser chos 'jam dpal nag po'i bsgom bzlas nyams su blang tshul kun dga'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /zab mo'i bsgom bzlas lhur len 'bya

tei:div.tei:p: (ja)༄༅// gser chos 'jam dpal nag po'i bsgom bzlas nyams su blang tshul kun dga'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs so// zab mo'i bsgom bzlas lhur len 'byer 'jig gis// bar chad mi mthun lha min dpung bcom nas// bde mchog mtho ris dbang 'byor 'jam dbyangs kyi// sgrub thabs zho 'thung rus pa'i rdo rje gdengs// 'dir rje btsun sa skya pa'i gser chos bcu gsum gyi ya gyal 'jam dpal nag po'i man ngag gi bsgom bzlas nyams su blang ba'i tshul la dngos dang phan yon gnyis/ dang po la gnad bcu gcig ste/ dang po dran pa dus kyi gnad ni/ tho rangs skya rengs shar ba'i dus so// gnyis pa lta ba phyogs kyi gnad ni/ rang kha shar du phyogs par ro// gsum pa bca' ba lus kyi gnad ni/ rkang pa gnyis skyil krung bcas te sgal tshigs drang por bsrang ngo*// bzhi pa 'bud pa rlung gi gnad ni/ rlung sna bug g.yas nas rngubs te g.yon nas sangs kyis 'bud pa lan gsum bya zhing*/ nang gi nad gdon bar chad thams cad bun gyis phyir thon par bsam mo// lnga pa bsgom pa lha'i gnad ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed spyi ltar sngon du 'gro bas/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs kyis chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin stong pa nyid du shes par byas/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ rang gi rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo dhīḥmathing nag las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid 'phags pa 'jam dpal sku mdog nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pas ral gri nam mkhar 'phyar ba/ g.yon pas ut+pa la'i yu ba thugs kar bzung nas/ 'dab ma snyan gyi thad kar kha gyes pa'i steng na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i po ti bsnams pa/ rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ dar gyi cod paṇa can/ ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i dbyings na zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs par bsam/

'di ni bsnyen pa dang rgyun gyi nyams len gyi tshe 'di kho na gtso bor bsgom/ gal te cho 'phrul che zhing the tshom dang rnam rtog cher za na/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng na skad cig gis rang nyid 'jam dpal khro bo sku mdog nag po/ dbu skra nag po spyi bor bcings pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pas ral gri me 'bar bas gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad la bsnun par byed pa/ g.yon po ti thugs kar bsnams pa/ spyan gsum dmar la zlum pa/ mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'dril ba/ lto ba che ba/ zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i spyi bor rtsa ba'i bla ma mi bskyod pa'i rnam pas bzhugs par bsgoms te/ bskyed chog 'di gnyis char la/ gnas gsum byin rlabs dang dgug gzhug sogs mi dgos pa'i khyad par ro// drug pa bzlas pa sngags kyi gnad ni/ rang lhar gsal bas/ oṃ pra sod/ chu sod/ dur ta sod/ snying mgo la chod/ kha la dzaḥ kaṃ shaṃ rbad phaṭa swā hā/ yang lugs gcig la/ oṃ pra sod/ chu sod/ dur ta sod/ dur mi sod/ snying mgo la chod/ kha la dzaḥ kaṃ shaṃ traṃ rbad swā hā/ zhes pa rtsa ba'i sngags 'di gnyis gang yang rung ba la/ grub na nyi shu rtsa gcig nas stong la sogs pa ci 'grub bzlas mthar/ rtsa sngags sham bur rims la/ sarba dz+wā rwaḥ nad la/ ro gāḥ gdon la/ duṣ+ṭān/ bgegs la/ bigh+nā na/ gzhan thams cad la/ u pa dra byāḥshān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes skabs su gang bab ltar gdags pa'ang ci nus bzlas so// bdun pa rten 'brel rdzas kyi gnad ni/ sngags bzlas pa'i mchil ma dang bcas te srin mdzub gnyis kyis rang gi rkang pa'i rgyud mo khug gnyis nas dri ma blang pa'o// brgyad pa byug pa bu ga'i gnad ni/ dri ma blangs pa des rang gi bu ga dgu dang bcu drug 'dzom rnams su byug go /dgu pa 'byed gcod sgo'i gnad ni/ phyi sgo ma phye gong du'o// bcu pa gdab pa rkan sgra'i gnad ni/

rkan sgra drag po lan gsum du gtogs so// bcu gcig pa bzlog pa mtheb rgya'i gnad ni/ rkang pa g.yas pa'i mthe bong g.yon pa'i sen mos mnan te/ tshangs pa'i 'jig rten man chad kyi rang la gnod pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad rkang 'og tu mnan par bsams la/ thal mo sbyar te/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi bar du gcod pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol/ zhes 'dod don gsol ba btab nas/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /'phags pa 'jam dpal 'grub gyur nas// zhes sogs bsngo ba smon lam gyi rgyas gdab/ gnyis pa ni/ de ltar nyams su blangs pas pha rol gyi rbod gtong drag po byas pa dang*/ rims sogs 'go ba'i nad dang gnyan rigs kyi nad thams cad dang*/ gdon chen pos gnod par dogs pa'i phyogs dang gza' skar ngan pa dang phyogs ngan bdud gcod kyi phyogs su 'gro ba/ khrom dang dge 'dun gyi tshogs dpon byed pa/ sa ma dul ba'i gnas su dbang bskur ba dang*/ hom dang ro sreg byed pa/ gtor zor 'phen pa sogs drag po'i las rtsom pa/ srod dang tho rengs la 'gro ba/ ro bag gi grib dang mi gtsang ba 'bags btsog la sogs pa grib kyi rigs thams cad dang gto bcos btang ba dang*/ skyas sna dang 'phrad pa sha ma chang ma/ shi ba'i bar chen/ sngon thal/ lag bde/ ro khur ba/ ro sna 'dren pa/ ro'i shul du nyal ba sogs 'dre can gdong thug gi gnod pa dang mtshan ltas ngan pa'i gnod pa thams cad kyis mi tshugs shing*/ sa gnyan brko ba/ shing gnyan gcod pa/ rdo gnyan bcog pa/ mkhar khang gsar du byed pa/ rnying pa bshig pa/ zar mi btub pa bza' ba/ nyor mi btub pa nyo ba sogs mdor na nyam nga ba'i rnam rtog ci byung yang*/ 'di nyams su blangs pas gnod pa thams cad kyis mi tshugs pa ni sngags rgod kyi nus pa yin pas gang la'ang rnam rtog dgos re kan zhes rje sa skya pas dbu snyung bzhes pa'i gdams pa zab mo mkhas shing grub pa'i dbang phyug rnams kyis thugs nyams su bzhes shing mi bslu ba myong bas grub pa nyid do// thun mtshams su gtor ma 'bul na/

zlum gtor chab kyis bran te/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs kyis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la/ gtor mgron spro na/ mdun gyi nam mkhar paṃ las pad+ma sogs nas skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i bar gyis bskyed/ bsdu na/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rje btsun 'jam dpal nag po mdun gyi nam mkhar skad cig gis rdo rje bsdu ba'i sngags rgyas spyan drangs la/ gang ltar yang oṃ ār+ya kṛṣ+ṇa mañdzu shrī oṃ a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gyis phul/ nyer spyod rnams kyis mchod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// mkhyen brtse nus pa'i ngo bo nyid// sgrub la dngos grub mchog stsol ba'i// yi dam lha la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces pas bstod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// zhes sogs nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod// ces pa'i bar gyis 'dod don gsol ba gdab/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bshags/ oṃ badz+ra muḥzhes pas ye shes pa gshegs su gsol ba'am mi dmigs pa'i ngang du gzhag go /bsnyen pa byed na gnad drug pa yan chad nyams su len cing rtsa sngags bzhi 'bum la sogs pa bsags pa'i rjes su/ sham bu btags pa rnams kyang mang nyung ci rigs pa re bzlas nas/ gtor ma 'bul ba'am dge ba bsngos la spyod lam thams cad du rang lha'i nga rgyal dang ma bral bar bya'o// bstan pa'i snang byed rje btsun brtse ba che'i// thugs ka'i bum bzang las 'phros gdams pa'i bcud// gab sbas 'khrugs bsdebs bgyis pa'i dge ba yis// 'gro kun mi mthun phyogs las rnam rgyal shog /ces gser chos 'jam dpal nag po'i bsgom bzlas nyams su blang tshul kun dga'i me long zhes bya ba 'di ni/

lhun grub steng gi dbu mdzad bla ma kun dga' bsod nams pa'i gsung bskul la cung zad 'gyangs bar/ slar par dpon tshul khrims ting 'dzin pa'i gsung gis bskul 'phral/ gong ma rnams kyi yig cha'i dgongs pa mi 'gal bar ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bsdebs pa swasti bi dza yan+tu// // ༄༅// gser chos 'jam dpal nag po'i rjes gnang bya tshul kun dga'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs// ༄༅// ches zab gdams pa'i rtse brgya gdengs tsam gyis// bar chad sbyin skyes dgra las rnam rgyal nas// bde legs yid bzang rgyal srid ster ba'i lha// 'jam dpal rjes gnang ngag gi 'dod 'jo spel// de'ang gser chos lugs kyi 'jam dpal nag po'i rjes su gnang ba ji ltar bya ba'i tshul la gnyis te/ slob dpon gyi bya ba dang*/ slob ma la bya ba'o// dang po la stegs kyi gzhir maṇ+ḍal tshom bu gcig par bkod/ de'i mdun du zlum gtor rgyan ldan dang mtha' skor du nyer spyod kyis bskor ba/ slob dpon gyi mdun du rdo rje dril bu me tog rnams bsham mo// de nas rang nyid stan la 'khod de/ mchod pa byin rlabs dang*/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed spyi ltar byas/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs brjod pas stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma sogs nas ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i dbyings na zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa zhes pa'i bar gyis skyil krung can gyi mngon rtogs gong bzhin bsgom/ bzlas pa ci nus byas mthar/ 'dod don gsol ba gdab/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas gdan 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur nas rang la thim par bsam/ mdun bskyed sgrub pa ni/ tshom bu la dmigs te/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ swa bhā wa sogs kyis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ dhīḥmathing nag las 'od 'phros sogs nas skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i bar gyis bskyed/

mchod pa byin rlabs byas/ oṃ ār+ya kṛṣ+ṇa mañdzu shrī sa pa ri wā ra sngon du 'gro ba'i chu gnyis nyer spyod dharma ra ṇi dang bcas pas mchod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas sogs spyi bstod bya/ gtor ma sgrub thabs ltar phul/ mdun bskyed la dmigs pa'i bzlas pa cung zad bya'o// gnyis pa slob ma la bya ba ni/ slob ma rnams khrus byas gral la 'khod pa la/ me tog bkye bsdu byas nas/ slob dpon gyis sems bskyed gsal gdab brjod rjes/ 'dir skabs su bab pa'i rjes su gnang ba ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che'i mnga' bdag rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras rnams la zab pa dang rgya che ba'i gdams pa rgya mtsho ltar mnga' ba'i nang nas/ mchog tu gyur pa zab chos lcags ri las mi 'da' ba'i gser chos bcu gsum gyi nang tshan/ bar du gcod pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal bar byed pa'i gdams pa khyad par can/ rje btsun 'jam dpal nag po skyil krung can gyi rjes su gnang ba sgrub pa la/ slob dpon gyis bgyi bar 'os pa thams cad legs par grub nas/ khyed rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa slob ma la bya ba'i rim pa la/ thog mar slob dpon rje btsun 'jam dpal nag po dang tha mi dad snyam pa'i mos gus dang ldan pas rjes su gnang ba zhu ba'i yon du dmigs nas maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba zhu/ maṇ+ḍal phul nas me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar te 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po sogs lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ rgyud dag pa'i slad du khyed rnams kyi mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i 'jam dpal nag po la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyi bskor ba'i spyan sngar bdag gzhan gyi sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa'i yan lag bdun pa bgyi snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs nas 'grub par shog ces lan gsum gyis sdom pa bzung ba rnams rjes gnang gi sngon 'gro yin/

dngos gzhi la rjes gnang gi gzhi dgod pa'i slad du slob dpon gyis/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs brjod pas khyed rnams kyi tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dang rnam smin gdos bcas kyi phung po khams dang skye mched la sogs pa snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis ma dmigs pa'i stong pa nyid 'od gsal nam mkha' lta bur gyur par mos/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma sogs nas skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i bar gyis slob ma lhar bskyed/ de ltar khyed rnams 'jam dpal nag por gsal ba'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying gar hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan par gsal btab/ slob dpon 'jam dpal nag por gsal ba dang*/ mdun bskyed kyi lha 'jam dpal nag po gnyis ka'i'ang dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan par bsams la/ slob dpon mdun bskyed dang bcas pa la mos gus byas pas/ slob dpon dang mdun bskyed kyi 'jam dpal gnyis ka'i dpral bar oṃ las/ 'jam dpal nag po'i sku'i ngo bo oṃ dkar po dpag tu med pa byung*/ khyed rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ de la thim pas/ 'jam dpal gyi sku'i byin rlabs thams cad rgyud la zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ slar yang slob dpon mdun bskyed dang bcas pa la mos gus byas pas/ slob dpon dang mdun bskyed kyi 'jam dpal gnyis ka'i mgrin pa'i āḥlas/ 'jam dpal nag po'i gsung gi ngo bo āḥdamar po dpag tu med pa byung*/ khyed rnams kyi mgrin pa'i āḥde la thim pas/ 'jam dpal gyi gsung gi byin rlabs thams cad rgyud la zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ slar yang slob dpon mdun bskyed dang bcas pa la mos gus byas pas/ slob dpon dang mdun bskyed kyi 'jam dpal gnyis ka'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las/ 'jam dpal nag po'i thugs kyi ngo bo hūm̐ sngon po dpag tu med pa byung*/

khyed rnams kyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ de la thim pas/ 'jam dpal gyi thugs kyi byin rlabs thams cad rgyud la zhugs pa'i mos pa bya ste/ mdor na 'jam dpal nag po'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs thams cad khyed rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum la zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod cig ces dang*/ rol mo byas la/ oṃ badz+ra ā we sha ya aḥ.aḥ.aḥzhes mang du brjod/ de nas bzlas lung gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon dang 'jam dpal tha dad ma mchis pa'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las skye ba'i tshul gyis sngags kyi phreng ba byung*/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas 'thon/ khyed rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim par mos te/ me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar nas/ sngags 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ gsum song ba dang*/ de ltar lan gsum bzlas pas dang pos rgyud byin gyis brlabs/ gnyis pas dbyer med du byas/ gsum pas brtan par byas par mos te/ slob dpon la me tog 'thor ba dang bcas te 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag gis gzung lags kyis// bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs// zhes lan gsum/ de ltar gsol ba btab nas/ slob dpon gyis kyang me tog phreng ba sngags su byas te khyed rnams kyi spyi bor bzhag ste byin gyis brlab par mos/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol// rdo rje'i slob ma'i rgyud la 'jam dpal nag po'i gsang sngags kyi byin rlabs dang nus mthu ma lus pa 'jug par gyur cig ces brjod cing me tog gtor/ slob dpon rang sngar bsgom lung thob pa zhig yin na/ bar 'dir gnad bcu gcig dang bcas pa'i bsgom lung sgrub thabs 'bogs/ de dag gi gnas skabs su thob pa'i dam tshig thams cad tshul bzhin du 'dzin snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

gtso bos ji ltar sogs dang*/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal dang*/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran sogs spyi dang mthun par bya'o// rjes mchod pa kha gsos pa byin gyis brlabs nas mdun bskyed la mchod bstod 'dod don zhus la/ yig brgyas lhag chad bskang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes pas tshom bu'i lha rang la thim par bsams la/ bsngo ba smon lam dang bkra shis kyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o// yang 'di'i rjes gnang gzhi de nyid las cung zad spros tsam byas pa la gnad bcu gcig gi sgom lung 'bogs pa dang bcas pa zhig bco brgyad pa byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub pa'i phyag len ltar rmor chen rjes mdzad pa'i yig cha'i steng nas rje de nyid nas kho bos thob cing*/ de ltar du byed par 'dod pas yig cha de'i lugs ltar rang gis thob nas/ de'i rgyun gzhan la'ang spel bar byas na legs par sems so// zhes gser chos 'jam dpal nag po'i rjes gnang bya tshul kun dga'i me long zhes bya ba 'di ni/ sa skya pa sngags 'chang kun dga' bsod nams pas mdzad pa'i yi ge cung zad tshig 'doms ches par brten/ phyis su yi ge de yang rang rang gis 'don bde ba'i ched du mchan btab pa dag kyang 'brel ma 'brel 'dra min sna tshogs shig byung ba dang*/ 'ga' zhig gcig shes kun grol rang gi blo ngo dang bstun pa sogs ci yang rung bas tshim par byed pa mthong nas/ rang dang skal mnyam 'ga' la phan par 'gyur srid snyam nas yi ge de nyid kyi bzhed pa ma 'phyugs par skabs 'gar nyams su blang bde ba'i ngag 'don bklag chog bstar te/ 'jam mgon bkra shis lhun grub pa dang*/ thams cad mkhyen pa tshul khrims lhun grub pa la sogs pa yongs 'dzin chos bzhin du mkhyen kyin chos bzhin 'doms pa rnams kyi phyag len ji ltar mdzad pa dran 'dzin du ban+de tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas/ sde dge lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab tu bris pa bi dza yan+tu//

//'di'i sgrub thabs kyi lung rjes gnang du bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ phyag na rdo rje/ dze tā ri pa/ bla ma rdo rje gdan pa chung ba/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ 'phags pa rin po che blo gros rgyal mtshan/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ brag phug pa bsod nams dpal/ ye shes dpal/ blo bzang dkar mo/ dkon mchog thugs rje/ gling smad paṇ+ḍi ta shes rab dpal ldan/ gong dkar rdo rje gdan pa kun dga' rnam rgyal/ slob dpon rin po che chos mchog mdo khams pa yon tan rgya mtsho/ gong dkar tshe dbang bkra shis/ rnam rgyal bkra shis/ rje dbang phyug rab brtan/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags/ mkhan chen ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ bdag chen ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis/ mkhan chen lhun grub dpal ldan/ 'jam mgon sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ thams cad mkhyen pa tshul khrims lhun grub/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen can la'o// yang na 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas phun tshogs nas/ rdo rje 'dzin pa bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ mkhan chen 'jam mgon bkra shis lhun grub/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na phan khang bstan 'dzin lhun grub pa nas/ mkhan chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la'o// yang na sangs rgyas phun tshogs nas/ grub dbang kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ des bdag la'o// yang na sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis/ rmor chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ des bdag la rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i yi ge'i steng nas rjes su gnang ba gnad bcu gcig gi bsgom lung 'bogs pa dang bcas pa legs par thob pa lags so// // ༄// seng ge'i gdong can ma'i sgrub thabs nyung 'dus bdud las rgyal ba'i bzhad sgra zhes bya ba bzhugs//

༄༅// na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ 'dir rje btsun sa skya pa'i gser chos lugs kyi seng ge'i gdong can ma'i bsgom bzlas nyams su blang ba'i tshul la/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// bdag sogs gtan gyi skyabs su gzung*// gzhan don bdud las rgyal bya'i phyir// ye shes khro mo bsgom par bgyi// lan gsum gyis skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byas/ oṃ chos kun stong pa'i ngang nyid las// hūm̐ las rdo rje'i srung 'khor che// pad nyi mi ro'i steng du bdag /ye shes mkha' 'gro seng ge'i gdong*// spyan gsum zhal gdangs mche ba gtsigs// mthing nag phyag g.yas gri gug 'phyar// g.yon na thod khrag mkha' dbyug 'khyud// mgo phreng rus rgyan stag sham bklubs// me dpung klong na brkyang bskum gar// dbang rtags rdo rjes spyi bor mtshan// sprul pa'i khro mo'i 'phro 'du yis// gnod byed bzlog cing tshar gcod mdzad// bzlas pa bya ba ni/ thugs ka'i nyi mar hūm̐ sngags phreng*// 'od kyi me 'bar gnod byed dang*// bsam sbyor ngan pa'i nus mthu bsregs// rgyal kun mthu stobs bdag la bsdus// zhes bsam zhing*/ aḥkaḥsaḥmaḥraḥtsaḥshaḥdaḥraḥsaḥmaḥyaḥraḥyaḥphaṭaḥ ci nus bzlas/ bzlog pa byed na/ sngags de'i mthar/ mi dang mi ma yin pa'i byad kha phur kha rbod gtong thams cad es bh+yoḥbh+yoḥbazlog bzlog ces btags pa ci nus bzlas mthar/ phyag gnyis nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor du bsams pa'i bar du gnod byed dgra bgegs dmigs la/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong can mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum sde'i tshogs dang bcas pa'i bden pa dang bden pa chen po'i byin gyis rlabs kyis/ su gang dag bdag cag gi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/

bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang*/ gdug pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang*/ drag shul gyi sems dang ldan pa rnams dang*/ bsam pa ngan pa dang sbyor ba rtsub mor brtsams pa'i byad kha rbod gtong rmi lam ngan pa/ mtshan ltas ngan pa/ dus ma yin par 'chi bar 'gyur ba la sogs pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad phyir bzlog par gyur cig med par gyur cig zhi bar gyur cig gal te zhi bar ma gyur pa de'i tshe/ gnod byed de dag thams cad kyi lus bcing bar bgyi'o// ngag bcing bar bgyi'o// yid bcing bar bgyi'o// mthu brlag par gyur cig rdzu 'phrul brlag par gyur cig stobs brlag par gyur cig des bzlas pa'i sngags kyis de nyid brlag par gyur cig des bsgrubs pa'i lha 'dres de nyid kyi sha za bar gyur cig ces pa'i bar brjod cing*/ thal mo lan gsum brdabs pas gnod byed kyi lus ngag nus mthu dang bcas rdul phran bzhin du brlag par bsams la/ khro mo 'bar ba'i tshogs rnams kyis// dgra bgegs rnams ni thams cad kyi// lus ngag thal ba rdul du rlog /rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su sgrol// zhes brjod cing bsgral bya/ sgrol byed/ sgrol ba po thams cad kyi rang bzhin dpyad na gshis lugs yod pa cir yang ma grub par shes pa de'i ngang du ci gnas su mnyam par gzhag de las ldang ba na/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /seng ge'i gdong can 'grub gyur nas zhes sogs bsngo ba dang smon lam gang shes brjod do// zhes gser chos lugs kyi seng ge'i gdong can ma'i sgrub thabs nyung 'dus bdud las rgyal ba'i bzhad sgra zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rgya mo rong pa'i dge slong bsod nams dpal ldan la sogs pa don gnyer 'gas rgyun du 'khyer bde zab mo zhig dgos zhes bskul ba'i ngor/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis lhun grub steng gi chos grwar sug bris su bgyis pa rnam par rgyal bar gyur cig
